About the academy

More than karate.

Bakwadi Karate Academy is a community where students can develop martial-arts skills while building discipline, respect, confidence and consistency.

Meet the instructor

Mpho Bakwadi

Mpho Bakwadi is the Chief Instructor of Bakwadi Karate Academy. He leads the club's karate training and helps create a structured environment where students can practise technique, discipline, respect and personal development.

The academy welcomes students to train at Jack's Gym Village during the weekly sessions listed on this website.
